panels.title: Sensor freshness — seconds since last reading (device × field)
panels.description: Each cell = seconds since that device's field last arrived. A red cell with green neighbours = that sensor dropped (e.g. BH1750 lux); a whole red row = the device is offline. New devices add rows, new sensors add columns automatically. Thresholds align with the controller's STALE=5min. The `as7341` column is the ambient spectrum feed, which lives in its own measurement rather than in `air`; it is here because without it a dead AS7341 left every other cell green for the whole outage (2026-08-14 and 08-16). A reflectance run pauses the ambient tick, but it pauses telemetry too, so during one the entire row ages together instead of that column alone — a lone red `as7341` really is the sensor.

panels.description:
BME680 量的是這座陽台本身的空氣，Open-Meteo 是板橋網格的區域值。**這不是室內外對比** —— 整套設備就在戶外，只是位於有雨遮的窄巷中，所以兩條線都是室外，差的是微氣候。溫差主要來自窄巷的日曬蓄熱與通風不良，不是牆或隔熱。

兩條線的取樣率差三個數量級：陽台每 15 秒，區域每小時。所以 spanNulls 只開在區域那條（虛線）。**陽台那條刻意不開** —— 開了之後感測器掉線會被畫成一條平滑直線而不是缺口，而 BME680 在 2026-08-15 就消失過 20 小時。缺口要看得見。

**第三條線 = SHT40，量的是防水盒內部**（2026-09-02 上線）。它和 BME680 不是同一個量測對象，所以兩條線分開是預期的，不是故障：30 分鐘均值 BME680 30.61°C / SHT40 30.25°C，**BME680 高 0.36°C**，方向與已知成因一致 —— BME680 的溫濕度來自同一顆跑 320°C 氣體加熱器的晶粒。真正該看的是**盒內減陽台**這個差值隨日照怎麼變：它就是這個外殼自己的蓄熱。

panels.title: DLI — daily light integral (mol/m²/day) — lux 法 vs 光譜法
panels.description:
同一件事的兩種算法，放同一個軸上比較 —— 因為它們的**比值**才是現在該看的東西。

**lux/54**（實心）：BH1750 的照度除以 Apogee 日光係數再積分。尺度可疑 —— 54 是為太陽光定的，套在 LED 植物燈上沒有物理依據。但它穩定，而且**這就是燈控實際依據的數字**：`light.py` 的 `todays_dli()` 與 `DLI_TARGET=4.0` 都在這條線上，兩者同一把尺，所以「今天達標沒」這個判斷是自洽的。

**光譜 PPFD**（虛線）：AS7341 八個 PAR 通道積分，物理上才是真正的 PAR。但它對 `CAL` 是純線性的（`DLI = CAL × ∫S dt`），而 CAL 目前還在漂：2026-08 量到 0.00133–0.00195，同一天晨窗與過中天就差 47%。面板現用 07-16 的 0.0017469。

所以現況是反過來的：**lux 法不精確但可靠，光譜法原理正確但暫時不能當絕對值讀。**兩條線的比值近 6 天在 0.50–0.68 之間游走，那個游走本身就是 CAL 尚未定案的證據。詳見 PPFD-CAL-ROUTINE-PLAN.md。

targets.query:
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Taipei")

from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "air" and r._field == "lux" and r.device == "livingroom")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 54.0 }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> integral(unit: 1s), createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1000000.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "lux/54（控制器依據）")

import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Taipei")
CAL = 0.0017469

from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "spectrum" and r.mode == "ambient" and r.device == "livingroom"
       and (r._field == "f415" or r._field == "f445" or r._field == "f480" or r._field == "f515"
         or r._field == "f555" or r._field == "f590" or r._field == "f630" or r._field == "f680"
         or r._field == "saturated"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.f415 and exists r.f445 and exists r.f480 and exists r.f515
       and exists r.f555 and exists r.f590 and exists r.f630 and exists r.f680)
  // 65535 is the I2C read-failure value, not light. Without this the fault mode
  // renders as a huge PPFD spike and inflates the day's integral.
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (not exists r.saturated or r.saturated == 0.0)
       and r.f415 < 65535.0 and r.f445 < 65535.0 and r.f480 < 65535.0 and r.f515 < 65535.0
       and r.f555 < 65535.0 and r.f590 < 65535.0 and r.f630 < 65535.0 and r.f680 < 65535.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: CAL * (r.f415/55.0*415.0 + r.f445/110.0*445.0
       + r.f480/210.0*480.0 + r.f515/390.0*515.0 + r.f555/590.0*555.0 + r.f590/840.0*590.0
       + r.f630/1350.0*630.0 + r.f680/1070.0*680.0) }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> integral(unit: 1s), createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1000000.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "光譜 PPFD (CAL=0.0017469)")

panels.title: PPFD (spectrum-derived, µmol·m⁻²·s⁻¹ — real PAR, calibration pending)
panels.description: Instantaneous PPFD from the AS7341 PAR spectrum: PPFD ≈ CAL · Σ(countᵢ / Rᵢ · λᵢ) over the 8 visible channels. Counts are first normalized by each channel's datasheet irradiance responsivity Rᵢ (warm-white 2700K @ 107.67µW/cm²: F1=55, F2=110, F3=210, F4=390, F5=590, F6=840, F7=1350, F8=1070 — the channels span ~25× in sensitivity), then photon-weighted by λ. The gain/integration scaling is common to all channels so it folds into CAL. Series labelled by device (staging-01 while indoors; livingroom once at the plant). CAL = 0.0017469 — calibrated by daylight×lux cross-cal (calibrate-ppfd.sh) over 2026-07-16 14:00–15:00 at ambient gain 4×: ratio-flat (9% drift), R²=0.99, tied to the BH1750 lux/54 reference so it stays consistent with the lux DLI panel. VALID ONLY at the 4× ambient gain (since firmware c9e0690) — re-derive with calibrate-ppfd.sh if gain/integration changes. DLI = the integral of this; the lux/54 DLI panel stays until DLI switches to spectrum.

panels.title: Optical throughput under the lamp — daily medians (the ratio alert's blind spot)
panels.description: The lamp is a controlled reference source: this room gets 1-2% of its daily light from the sun, so during lamp hours the illumination is fixed and a daily median isolates the sensor and its optical path. The `spectrum-throughput-drift` alert watches the RATIO of these two, which cannot see COMMON-MODE degradation — 2026-08-05 to 08-08 both sensors fouled together, the lamp-window lux halved, and the ratio moved only 6.33 to 7.51. Watch for both lines falling together: that is the case the alert will not catch. Steps are expected after a window clean or a sensor swap (07-22 +4x, 07-29 +1.7x, 08-11 replacement) — note them, and re-derive the alert band and CAL afterwards.

panels.title: WiFi 訊號 vs 發送間隔 — 停頓是不是訊號造成的
panels.description:
韌體 5d683f8 加的診斷欄位，目的寫在它自己的註解裡：correlate weak rssi with freezes/gaps。所以這裡不只畫訊號，而是把訊號和發送間隔疊在同一條時間軸上 —— 兩者同時出現異常，才是「WiFi 送出時卡住」的證據。

左軸 RSSI (dBm，取窗內最差值)：> -67 可靠、-67～-80 邊緣、< -80 差。
右軸 發送間隔 (秒，取窗內最長)：正常 15 秒；抬高 = 那一輪 loop 卡住了。

判讀：間隔尖峰同時伴隨 RSSI 下陷 → 網路送出阻塞；間隔尖峰而 RSSI 平穩 → 卡在別的地方（I2C、SPI、HX711），跟 WiFi 無關。後者正是 2026-08-14 到 08-16 AS7341 掉線時的樣子，發送間隔從 15 秒變成 17.5 秒而訊號完全沒動。

間隔取自 rssi 自己的樣本間距，因為韌體只在 WiFi 連線時才寫這個欄位，等於每次成功發送必然有它。
